title: A Drop for the Safehouse
author: Felix Vane
blurb: Astrid Vasquez, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
